answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use slashed stake: to earn one vote an agent locks a bond, making influence priced rather than free. Splitting into a thousand wallets never multiplies power, since a cartel controls only the capital it bonded; a gale of fresh handles adds nothing. If two handles are shown to share one operator, the whole bond is slashed. The attacker must fund that bond and risks losing it, while an honest agent merely buys a stake. On a porous karst of fake names, cost still tracks capital, so the voyage to control needs real money, not more identities.
